subject: SLO visibility & monitoring provisioning — procurement questionnaire
messages:
From: GreenWave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.io>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@greenwave.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement questionnaire — SLO measurement and dashboard access

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement process we have a short SLO/monitoring questionnaire attached (GreenWave_procurement_q_v2.pdf). The key items we need clarified are:

- How Redwood defines and measures uptime and latency SLOs (exact metric names, aggregation windows, percentiles).
- Whether the metrics we rely on (p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx/error rates, request volume) are available in a customer-facing dashboard and whether customers can get read-only Grafana/Prometheus access or API extracts.
- Alerting behavior: what thresholds trigger on-call paging vs email, and who we contact for urgent incidents.
- How scheduled maintenance and planned degradations are treated for SLO calculations (exceptions/credit policy).
- Metric retention windows and access to raw historical traces/logs for audits.

We generally prefer read-only dashboard access plus an automated daily metrics export into our observability workspace. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports this or what the recommended pattern is?

Please see the attached and let me know if you prefer a short call. We'd ideally close procurement questions by end of week.

Best,
Procurement Team
GreenWave Analytics

Attachment: GreenWave_procurement_q_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement questionnaire — SLO measurement and dashboard access

Hi — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. I attached a short primer (SLO-Measurement-Brief.pdf) that addresses the top-level asks; Laura (engineering) is cc'd with the technical details below.

Quick answers:
- Metric names and definitions: we publish standardized metrics (inference_request_latency_ms, inference_error_rate, inference_success_count) and compute rolling-window percentiles (p50/p95/p99) over a 7-day sliding window by default; we can configure windows per-customer in Dedicated/Private customers.
- Customer visibility: we offer a customer-facing Grafana view (read-only role) and an API to pull aggregated daily metrics. For enterprise contracts we can provision a Prometheus federation endpoint or scheduled CSV exports.
- Alerting: default critical alerts are paged to our on-call SRE (PagerDuty) at the p99 > SLA threshold for > 5m sustained; warnings are email/Slack. We can also configure a dedicated escalation path for GreenWave.
- Maintenance exceptions: scheduled maintenance windows are excluded from SLO calculations if notified 72+ hours in advance and posted in our status calendar; emergency maintenance follows a documented exception review and may result in credit where appropriate.

Laura will follow up with specifics about instrumentation, retention, and access. If this looks good we can schedule a 30-minute technical alignment tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Procurement questionnaire — technical details on metrics and retention

Hi Sarah / Procurement team,

Looping in the tech details you asked for. Below is a concise reference you can paste into your security/procurement form. Happy to fill any fields in the PDF directly if you share the editable file.

SLO measurement (deltas and what we exclude):
- Latency metric: inference_request_latency_ms. Measured at the edge gateway after request auth and before tokenization; includes model generation time.
- Percentiles: we calculate p50/p95/p99 using TDigest-based streaming aggregation. Default evaluation window: 7-day sliding window, 5-minute evaluation buckets.
- Error rate: inference_error_rate = 5xx + application-level reject codes (client validation). Errors are counted per-request.
- Availability SLO: defined as % of requests that complete without 5xx within a 1s threshold for short prompt profiles (configurable).

Monitoring and customer access:
- Grafana: read-only Grafana instance per-customer with pre-built dashboards (latency distribution, error rates, request volume, regional breakdown). We support SSO with SAML/OIDC and can provision accounts tied to your IdP.
- Prometheus: for Dedicated/Private customers we provide a Prometheus federation endpoint (scrape-limited) or a remote write capability. Hosted customers may request daily exports (CSV/JSON) for ingestion into your observability pipeline.
- Raw logs/traces: retained for 90 days by default; can extend to 1 year under enterprise agreements. Access to raw traces requires an approved data access request and can be provided as time-windowed exports.

Alerting and paging:
- Default rules: p99 latency breach > SLA for 5 continuous minutes triggers PagerDuty urgent page. Error-rate > 0.5% for 10m triggers a high-priority incident.
- Customization: thresholds, notification channels (email, Slack, PagerDuty key), and escalation policy are configurable per-customer. We provide an SLA runbook for on-call response times and RCA timelines.

SLO exceptions and credits:
- Planned maintenance: if scheduled >=72h and posted on status.redwood.ai, the window is excluded from SLO math.
- Emergency/unplanned: handled case-by-case; we maintain an exceptions log and provide credits per contractual terms where responsibility is accepted.

Retention & security:
- Metrics retention: aggregated time-series retained for 13 months; raw event logs 90 days (extendable).
- Identity & access: read-only dashboard users are scoped to non-exporting roles unless a data transfer agreement is in place.

Attached: slo_spec_matrix.xlsx — a mapping of customer-facing metrics to internal telemetry and recommended export patterns.

Next steps: if you want Grafana read-only access we can provision a SAML test account and invite your security contact. Proposed technical sync: Tue 15 Jun 10:00am PT (calendar invite to follow).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Observability
Redwood Inference
